items.markdown: To a solution of **compound 21-3** (10 mg, 0.04 mmol) in DCM (1 mL) were added 5-methyl-1H-indazol-4-amine (7.2 mg, 0.05 mmol), Titanium tetraisopropanolate (37 mg, 0.13 mmol). The reaction mixture was stirred at 25 ℃ for 12 h. After the addition of NaBH3CN (5.5 mg, 0.09 mmol), the mixture was further stirred at 25 ℃ for 2 hr. The reaction mixture was filtered and concentrated under reduced pressure to give a residue, which was purified by Prep-HPLC to afford the title compound (1.14 mg, 7.2% yield). LCMS (ESI<sup>+</sup>): 358.3 [M+H]<sup>+</sup>; <sup>1</sup>H NMR (400 MHz, DMSO-*d*6) δ 12.64 (s, 1H), 8.60 (s, 1H), 7.86 (s, 1H), 7.27 – 7.17 (m, 1H), 7.13 – 7.08 (m, 2H), 7.05 (d, _J_ = 8.3 Hz, 1H), 6.74 (d, _J_ = 8.2 Hz, 1H), 5.65 (t, _J_ = 6.3 Hz, 1H), 4.85 (d, _J_ = 6.1 Hz, 2H), 2.61 (s, 3H), 2.26 (s, 3H), 1.95 (s, 6H).
